headword: {大量殺人|たいりょうさつじん}

definitions.explanation: The killing of a large number of people, typically in a single incident or by a single perpetrator or group. Used in news reporting, criminal-law discussions, and historical descriptions of atrocities and terror attacks.

examples.japanese: {大量殺人|たいりょうさつじん}⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧。
⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{大量殺人|たいりょうさつじん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{罪|つみ}→罪：03532_tsumi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{起訴|きそ}→起訴：10577_kiso⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The perpetrator was indicted for mass murder.

examples.japanese: ⟦{戦争|せんそう}→戦争：01450_sensou⟧⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧{大量殺人|たいりょうさつじん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{真相|しんそう}→真相：17447_shinsou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{明|あき}らかにする→明らかにする：22256_akirakanisuru⟧。
examples.english: Uncover the truth about the mass killings committed during the war.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{博物館|はくぶつかん}→博物館：01494_hakubutsukan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{二十世紀|にじっせいき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{世界|せかい}{各地|かくち}→世界各地：24526_sekaikakuchi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{起|お}こった→起こる：01910_okoru⟧{大量殺人|たいりょうさつじん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{伝|つた}えている→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧。
examples.english: This museum conveys the history of mass killings that took place around the world in the twentieth century.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{大量|たいりょう}→大量：03112_tairyou⟧ (large quantity, mass) and ⟦{殺人|さつじん}→殺人：13236_satsujin⟧ (murder, homicide). A compound that combines a quantifier prefix with a crime term — the same pattern appears in ⟦{大量|たいりょう}→大量：03112_tairyou⟧⟦{逮捕|たいほ}→逮捕：03397_taiho⟧ (mass arrests) or ⟦{大量|たいりょう}{生産|せいさん}→大量生産：12523_tairyouseisan⟧ (mass production).

USAGE:
A grave word used in news, legal contexts, academic writing, and historical discussion. Not a casual expression. Refers to incidents with many victims — a single murder is not {大量殺人|たいりょうさつじん}, no matter how brutal.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大量殺人|たいりょうさつじん}⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧: mass murder case
- {大量殺人|たいりょうさつじん}{犯|はん}: mass murderer
- {大量殺人|たいりょうさつじん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{罪|つみ}→罪：03532_tsumi⟧: the crime of mass murder
- {大量殺人|たいりょうさつじん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{犯|おか}す→犯す：10059_okasu⟧: to commit mass murder

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{虐殺|ぎゃくさつ}→虐殺：14333_gyakusatsu⟧: massacre, genocide — implies brutality and often applies to wartime atrocities and ethnic killings; strongly emotional
- {無差別殺人|むさべつさつじん}: indiscriminate killing — emphasizes that victims are unrelated and chosen at random
- {大量虐殺|たいりょうぎゃくさつ}: mass slaughter, genocide — stronger and more emotive than {大量殺人|たいりょうさつじん}
- ⟦{連続殺人|れんぞくさつじん}→連続殺人：26282_renzokusatsujin⟧: serial murder — killings committed in succession over a period, distinct from a single mass incident
